p: Soundtracks, original songs, musical ideas, cue-driven scoring and creative music production.
Composes full multi-movement compositions with cohesive motifs, verse-chorus-bridge progressions, and orchestral codas.
Automated tempo ramps, harmonic tension builds, and dynamic hits synchronized to scene cuts and dramatic beats.
Generates separate mixable stems: lead vocal, backing vocal, drums, bass, rhythm guitars, synthesizers, and orchestral strings.
Explicit direction over key signatures, modes (Dorian, Mixolydian, etc.), time signatures, BPM tempos, and arrangement density.
Draft, test, and orchestrate hybrid orchestral and electronic scores tailored directly to picture edits.
Compose layered stems that dynamically fade in, intensify, or resolve based on in-game combat states.
Produce original, broadcast-cleared signature themes and underscores without production music library compromises.

h2: Try Uta on your own work

p: Samples of Uta's own output publish only after blind review, so the pictures here are illustrations. A studio can apply now to test it in its own pipeline.
